CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION by PASSWORD ='XYZ_ABC256'

-- CREDENTIAL -- 
create DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL adlssynapse1
WITH
    IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'

--- CREATE EXTERNAL DATA Source --
CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE ext_11
WITH(
    LOCATION = 'https://databdataftrial.dfs.core.windows.net/synapse',
    CREDENTIAL = adlssynapse1
)

-- Using OPENROWSET Function --

SELECT *
FROM 
OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'Revenue',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'ext_11',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
)as query1
